title: Treaty of Paris (1796)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Paris (1796)", at revision 1379704466, opens: "The Treaty of Paris of 15 May 1796 was a treaty between the French Republic and the Kingdom of Piedmont-Sardinia during the War of the First Coalition." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q249691, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1796 treaty between Kingdom of Sardinia and France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
